name: Battle Monks of Cathay

specialRules.name: Strictures
specialRules.text: Dragon Monks and Warrior Monks never wear any kind of armour.

specialRules.name: Distaste for Poison
specialRules.text: Dragon Monks and Warrior Monks may never use any kind of poison or venom.

specialRules.name: Outsiders
specialRules.text: May never hire any Hired Sword or Dramatis Personae unless specifically stated with the Hired sword/Dramatis Personae.

specialRules.name: Characteristic increase
specialRules.text: Cathayans are humans and use the maximum profile for humans.

items.name: Quarter staff
items.note: Common, Battle Monks only. Strength as user; Balanced (+1 Initiative in close combat), Parry, Freestyle (can be combined with the monk's bare-hand attacks, still gaining +1 Attack).

items.name: Chain sticks
items.note: Rare 7, Battle Monks only. Strength as user; Flurry (+2 Attacks in the first turn of each hand-to-hand combat; otherwise counts as two hand weapons), Two-handed.

items.name: Fish-hook shot
items.note: Rare 7, Battle Monks only. Range 3"; Strength 3; Thrown weapon (no range/move penalties), Precise (may attack enemies engaged in close combat; useless if the monk is in close combat), Caused fall (after a successful hit, enemy must pass a Strength test or is knocked down; +1 to the test vs large models; a mount knocked down makes the rider fall).

fighters.name: Emissary

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" may use this model's Leadership when taking Leadership tests.

specialRules.name: Decree
specialRules.text: When the Emissary dies, a new one must be hired as soon as possible; until then no other warriors and/or equipment may be bought. The new Emissary reclaims Leadership of the warband.

specialRules.name: Warmonger
specialRules.text: The Emissary may only pick the Warmonger special skill from the Special skill table: before a battle he may make a Ld test; on success D3+1 Raging Peasants join the warband for the next game (may exceed the maximum number of warriors) and are subject to Hatred for the duration of the battle.

fighters.notes: Skill table Special column is restricted to Warmonger for the Emissary.

specialRules.name: Unarmed fighting
specialRules.text: No penalties for fighting unarmed and receives +1 Attack when doing so.

specialRules.name: Art of Silent Death
specialRules.text: Fighting unarmed, causes a critical hit on a roll to wound of 9-12 instead of a natural 12. If wielding a quarter staff, only the unarmed attacks cause a critical hit, on 9+.

specialRules.name: Unarmed fighting
specialRules.text: No penalties for fighting unarmed and receives +1 Attack when doing so.

fighters.name: Raging Peasants
fixedEquipment: Pitchfork, torch or other simple tool (treat as fighting unarmed but without any penalties)

specialRules.name: Mob
specialRules.text: Gets +1 Ld for each other allied Peasant within 3". Does not benefit from the leader rule.

specialRules.name: Ignored
specialRules.text: Peasants that are out of action do not count towards the number of out of action models for Rout tests.

specialRules.name: Downtrodden
specialRules.text: When a Peasant is wounded do not roll for injury; the model is immediately taken out of action.

conversionNotes: Art of Silent Death: 'critical hit on a roll to wound of 5-6 instead of a 6' -> 9-12 instead of natural 12; quarter staff 'on 5+' -> 9+.
Warmonger 'D3+1 Raging Peasants' is a quantity, not a threshold, and was left unchanged.
Officer's Weapons/Armour text says only 'weapons chosen from the Soldier Equipment list'; given the Soldier list includes armour, assumed he may buy armour too (check).

Emissary skill table columns: Shooting, Academic, Speed, Special (restricted to Warmonger). Officer: Combat, Shooting, Strength, Speed. Dragon Monk: Combat, Academic, Strength, Speed, Special. Special = Battle Monks special skills (Energy Focus, Lightning Speed, Leap of Faith, Human Shield, Warmonger).
Cathayan longsword, Cathayan silk cloak and Horse are Emissary only (shown in note on list items). Monk list armour is 'None'. Raging Peasants have no equipment list.
Stats limits: maximum 15 warriors; Officer 0-1; Dragon Monks 0-3; Warrior Monks 0-5; Raging Peasants 0-5; Soldiers unlimited.
